text:
Maya: Flagging a weird skew with FP8-AWQ on batcher cold starts — accuracy drops on the first ~30 requests when the prefix KV cache is empty. Anyone seen this? :thinking:
Cheng: Seen something similar with hybrid AWQ. My hunch is kv-cache warmup + continuous batching coalescing different quant kernels, causing transient model state mismatch. Can you paste numbers? :eyes:
Maya: Quick eval from this morning (shadow, same model):
```
eval_set: 2k prompts
baseline (fp8-awq, cache warmed): accuracy=89.1%  ppl=12.4
coldstart, batcher ON, prefetch ON: accuracy=88.3%  ppl=13.0  (delta -0.8)
coldstart, batcher ON, prefetch OFF: accuracy=88.6%  ppl=12.8  (delta -0.5)
int8-gptq (cache warmed): accuracy=88.9% ppl=12.6
```
These are small but consistent across seeds. Also seeing a tail latency bump on first 20s after model load.
Oliver: Important: what's the batcher wait threshold and prefetch TTL for that run? Also which rollout type (shadow/canary/prod)?
Maya: Shadow run on canary infra. Config snippet used: 
```
batcher.max_wait_ms=12
batcher.max_tokens=2048
batcher.min_batch_size=4
prefetch.enabled=true
prefetch.ttl_ms=30000
cache.prefix_ttl_ms=15000
quant.profile=awq-fp8
warmup.pings=0
```
Simone: Two experiments to try: 1) disable prefetch so the cache only warms deterministically per request, 2) enable continuous batching but set a small min_batch_size and issue a short warmup ping (x5) immediately after load to prime KV. Also add a seqhash+kvversion logging counter.
Maya: Did a follow-up shadow with prefetch OFF + warmup.pings=5 and min_batch_size=2. Cold-start delta dropped from ~0.8% to ~0.12%. Latency went up ~+10ms median but much more stable across the initial window. Logs showed repeated lines: `WARN seqhash mismatch (expected v27, saw v26)` around the batcher handoff.
Cheng: Sounds like a seqhash/vversion race where different quant kernels (FP8 vs AWQ int fallback) are selected inside a single continuous batch. Filing IR-3127 for infra to check kernel selection ordering and kv-version tagging. Assigning to @Oliver. Can we add a metric `batch.kv_version_mismatch` and a trace tag? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Oliver: Ack, will add a counter and a lightweight tracer hook. Also want to repro with a smaller synthetic load to capture the exact batch boundary.
deploy-bot: Shadow job 2469127990-quant-coldstart started on canary; artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/2469127990/summary.json :white_check_mark:
